What is the equation of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
From the diagram we see that the arms of the parabola open to the right. The parabola has its vertex at $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(8,8).$

The general standard equation of a parabola whose vertex is $(0,0)$ and whose arms open right or left is given by

$$
{y}^{2}=4px.
$$

Since we know the given parabola passes through the point $(8,8),$ we can substitute $x=8$ and $y=8$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {8}^{2} & =4p(8) \\ 64 & =32p \\ p & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {y}^{2} & =4(2)x \\ {y}^{2} & =8x.\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that the arms of the parabola open to the right since $p=2$ is positive.
